    elif 100 <= step_count < 200:
        # Rotate base to arm1 joint clockwise to lift arm
        joint1.motorSpeed = 1.0

    elif 200 <= step_count < 300:
        # Keep arm1 position
        joint1.motorSpeed = 0.0
        # Rotate arm1 to scoop joint clockwise to tilt scoop upward
        joint2.motorSpeed = 1.0
    # Phase 4: Return to scoop position (300 <= step_count < 400)
    elif 300 <= step_count < 400:
        # Rotate base to arm1 joint counterclockwise to swing arm back toward pit
        joint1.motorSpeed = -1.0
        # Rotate arm1 to scoop joint counterclockwise to lower scoop
        joint2.motorSpeed = -1.0
    else:
        # Repeat cycle
        joint1.motorSpeed = -1.0
